title: Alþingi extension of the auðlegðarskattur, 2013-2014 votes
notes: Resolved via XML API: Roll call vote 49497 on 2013-12-19 was specifically on Item 2 of þingskjal 395 (143rd session) extending auðlegðarskattur. Seven MPs voted JÁ (Steingrímur J. Sigfússon, Katrín Jakobsdóttir, Árni Þór Sigurðsson, Bjarkey Gunnarsdóttir, Lilja Rafney Magnúsdóttir, Ólafur Þór Gunnarsson, Sigríður Ingibjörg Ingadóttir).
